Stacked ensemble for NBA (Nature Scientific Reports, 2025)

proposals.title: Venn-Abers Post-Training Calibration
proposals.rationale: Research confirms Venn-Abers calibration outperforms both Platt scaling (sigmoid) and isotonic regression for tree ensembles. Our current islands use raw probabilities or basic calibration. Fleet best is 0.22169; Venn-Abers has shown 0.003-0.005 Brier improvement in comparable settings, potentially pushing us past the 0.21837 checkpoint threshold.

implementation.code:
from venn_abers import VennAbersCalibrator

# After fitting base model:
calibrator = VennAbersCalibrator(estimator=base_model, inductive=True, cal_size=0.2)
calibrator.fit(X_train, y_train)
proba = calibrator.predict_proba(X_test)
# Use (p0 + p1) / 2 as final probability
target_files: Add venn-abers to requirements.txt on all islands
implementation.risk: LOW — post-processing only, no model changes

proposals.title: Extended Rolling ELO Feature Set
proposals.rationale: 2025-2026 research consistently identifies team_elo, team_elo_5_y (5-year form ELO) as top-3 most influential features. Our engine has basic ELO but lacks rolling-window variants. Adding elo_5game, elo_10game, elo_away_5game rolling windows could unlock new signal.

new_features: elo_home_5game_rolling: ELO delta over last 5 home games
elo_away_5game_rolling: ELO delta over last 5 away games
elo_opponent_form_5: Opponent's ELO trend over last 5 games
implementation.risk: LOW — additive features, GA will select/reject naturally

proposals.title: CalibratedClassifierCV Auto-Select (sklearn fallback)
proposals.rationale: sklearn's CalibratedClassifierCV with cv=5 auto-selects between sigmoid and isotonic per fold. 2025 study shows this achieves Brier 0.199 for logistic regression on NBA data. Apply as a lightweight alternative to Venn-Abers for islands that can't install the venn-abers package.

implementation.code:
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
cal_model = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_model, method='isotonic', cv=5)
cal_model.fit(X_train, y_train)
target_files: hf-space/app.py — wrap model in CalibratedClassifierCV after training
implementation.risk: LOW — sklearn built-in, no new dependencies

proposals.title: Shot-Chart Spatial Embedding Features (GPU path)
proposals.rationale: 2026 MDPI paper uses spatial shot-chart embeddings with RNN+MCDropout achieving well-calibrated probabilities. CPU islands cannot use RNN, but shot-chart zone aggregates (paint_pct_last5, mid_range_pct_last5, 3pt_zone_pct_last5) can be extracted as tree-compatible features.

new_features: paint_pct_last5: Fraction of shots in paint, last 5 games
midrange_pct_last5: Mid-range shot frequency, last 5 games
fastbreak_rate_last5: Fast break points per game, last 5 games
